limitations: Band-limited synthetic spectra, not external measured validation.
NIST line strengths are normalized within each element; weights are contribution ratios, not concentrations.
Profiles and response slopes are controlled approximations, not measured detector responses.
Only five training seeds; bootstrap coverage and discovery claims are not established.
Grid comparisons keep RMS SNR fixed with independent readout streams; they do not hold detector exposure or photon budget fixed.
interval_method: Percentile hierarchical bootstrap at configuration.confidence_level; seed resampling then base-group resampling; no resampling noise rows independently
paired_comparisons: Identical seed/group draws across models and grids; no multiplicity correction; exploratory intervals

metric_estimands.mean_std: mean and sample SD over the five seed metrics
metric_estimands.estimate_ci: pooled metric; seed/base-group hierarchical percentile interval
